args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions taken:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api v2.3.1 deployed to production (us-east, us-west, eu-west) was unhealthy in all regions with an 18% error rate and failing health checks.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled back to v2.3.0 — the most recent version with a healthy production deployment record — in all production regions. Rollback was verified as successfully rolled out.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident (INC-0001)**: Documented the failure of v2.3.1, the root-cause scope (all production regions), and the rollback to v2.3.0, with a note for follow-up investigation before redeploying v2.3.1. The on-call engineer has been paged.
